title: 云依助手 0.13.3
releaseNotes: Unifies all desktop business confirmations under one client-centered dialog, including database write enablement and SQL execution, Modbus writes, character deletion, process termination, uninstall and named residual cleanup. Preserves cancel-first focus, reviewed targets, full-name checks and native protections. Database approvals freeze SQL and database identity and cannot be reused after an error. Keeps Windows file pickers, startup-error fallbacks and Yiyi interaction clouds unchanged. All 20 tools and the packaged pink Yiyi character are retained.
